ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7), and remind the driver that the "I'm Here" arrival indicator and the subsequent >3-minute wait must be consistent with GPS at the pickup point.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: chat contains only pickup-arrangement and cancellation messages; driver statement and complaint contain no threat, harassment, abuse or dangerous-driving allegation. safety_concern = none.

No-show analysis (NS-0 → NS-1 / NS-2). cancelled_by = driver and the driver claims the rider no-showed, so NS-1 governs. NS-1 requires (i) an "I'm Here" tap or platform arrival confirmation, (ii) GPS showing the driver at the pickup point at that moment, and (iii) a continuous >3-minute wait within 200 m of the pickup afterwards.

(i) The timeline shows driver_pressed_here_at = 13:02:35; the driver's statement confirms he pressed "I'm Here". (ii) GPS at 13:02:30 places the driver at (1.352366, 103.944349) — about 62 m from the pickup (1.3525, 103.9447). That is within the 200 m arrival radius, so this element holds; the driver's stay there (13:02:30–13:05:30) further corroborates it. (iii) The driver cancelled at 13:05:30, only 2 min 55 s (175 s) after the 13:02:35 tap — measured from the tap, the wait does not exceed 3 minutes (NS-1(iii) requires >180 s). Even measured generously from the first stationary sample at 13:02:30, the elapsed time to cancellation is 180 s, i.e. exactly 3:00, which still fails the ">3 min / ≥3:01" requirement. The driver's chat message "More than 3 min already, I have to cancel" at 13:05:20 and his statement that he "waited more than 3 minutes" are contradicted by the system timeline (system records override statements), and the preceding mobile period (12:58–13:02) is driving, not waiting at the pickup, so it does not count under NS-1(iii).

Because element (iii) fails, NS-2 applies: the $6.61 cancellation fee is refunded in full. No flag_account is warranted — the driver was genuinely at the pickup at the tap, so the NS-2 fraud trigger (tapping "I'm Here" while not at the pickup) is not met, and RD-6 is not engaged (no route deviation in this case). Refund to be issued as a voucher per NS-7.

Evidence status: sufficient — the timeline, GPS trace and cancellation timestamps settle every element needed; the GPS 30 s sampling even at the disputed 180 s boundary is corroborated by the 5 s thinned grid and no gap >2 min exists.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver claims he waited more than 3 minutes after pressing I'm Here; the timeline shows the tap at 13:02:35 and cancellation at 13:05:30 = 175 s, and even counting from the first stationary GPS sample at 13:02:30 only 180 s (3:00), which does not exceed the >3-minute threshold in NS-1(iii).
"More than 3 min already" is contradicted by the system timeline; the wait in range was under (or at most exactly) 3 minutes.
Rider's framing that the driver cancelled before the 3-minute wait matured is accepted on the timeline, but no additional compensation beyond the $6.61 fee arises under any cited clause.
